name: Title menu
criteria: The menu screenshot shows the logo, Play, Settings and Quit, readable at 1280x720 and 390x844
Every button works with mouse, keyboard (Tab, Enter) and a gamepad (tools/pad.mjs shows each press reaching its button)
The menu reaches first paint in under 300 ms on npm run bench:menu (median of 5)
notes: Replace the placeholder menu with the design in docs/BRIEF.md, section Menu.
evidence: Screenshots at both sizes, the pad log, and the bench numbers, on main and on the branch.

name: Sound
criteria: tools/render-sounds.mjs writes a WAV and a loudness line for every sound in docs/BRIEF.md, section Sound
One-shots of the same kind sit within 3 LU of each other, and the master's true peak stays under -1 dBTP
notes: The menu's button sounds come from the menu line, so this line starts once it has merged.

name: Hero model
criteria: The hero reads as the character in docs/reference/hero.png from the game camera (tools/screens.mjs --only hero)
At most 8,000 triangles, and assets/src/hero.py rebuilds it byte for byte
notes: Replaces the capsule stand-in wave 1 put in the game. Every round that beats what main has merges at once.
